title: Building-site coordinate conversion and actor handoff follow-up
scope: Static RE of selected BuildStructure site pair through conversion, field-query branches, and component vtable handoff. No game/save/Godot/build execution or mutation.

input_identity.address_convention: Raw ELF VAs and PCs are recorded; Ghidra display function labels add 0x100000.

evidence_levels.EF: Input binary identity and/or raw AArch64 instruction evidence.
evidence_levels.PSEUDO: Static native decompilation or direct-call flow; not a live gameplay invocation.
evidence_levels.STRUCT: Argument, field, vector-lane, or grid record shape established from native access patterns.
evidence_levels.OPEN: Required semantic or runtime join not proven by this trace.

decompilation_sources.role: Selected pair parser and offset adjustment
s32 pair to float vector conversion
Actor flag branch and coordinate helpers
Index-category predicate used by branch B

behavior.first: s32 at parser source +0x8 is converted to float and emitted at vector lane +0x0 as value*10+5
behavior.second: s32 at parser source +0xc is converted to float and emitted at vector lane +0x8 as value*10+5
behavior.middle_lane: vector lane +0x4 is not written by 0x568360
behavior.pre_adjustment: 0x4e1670 prepares an adjusted pair using one value + (another >> 1) and the other value +1 before calling 0x568360

findings.confidence: high for arithmetic and call chain; conditional for naming source members mUnitX/mUnitZ because runtime list instance is not bound to StructurePresetA00
limits: No axis swap or sign conversion is present in this helper
No Y, rotation, terrain-height, or footprint transform is produced here

findings.behavior: 0x52b280 maps vector lanes 0 and 2 to floor(coord/5) indices; both helpers resolve a field/grid record and inspect type/state predicates.
findings.confidence: high for coordinate quantization and record-query call path; low/unassigned for gameplay semantics of the predicates
limits: Not proven to be a structure collision/overlap validator
The fact that emitted site centers fall on odd five-unit grid indices does not establish a global origin

call_pcs.instruction: BLR X8 with X0=component and X1=pair
BLR X8 after loading component vtable +0x158

findings.behavior: The selected pair is passed in X1 through the 0xbe6340 call to 0x2eae0. That routine calls the dynamic component vtable slot +0x128 with the pair. The common caller later dispatches a separate scalar pointer through actor-component slot +0x158 and stores a selected scalar at actor +0x610.
findings.confidence: high for runtime argument and slot offsets; unresolved for destination method implementation
limits: Object at actor +0x68 has no resolved static vtable instance in this call chain
The +0x128 target cannot be named from this indirect callsite
No final transform store is shown in the statically recovered call chain

findings.behavior: Actor byte +0x5ad bit 1 selects coordinate-dependent branches. Each helper converts horizontal coordinates to the five-unit grid and resolves a field record. The first also queries record type/state helpers; the second checks an index-category predicate. On success, component and scalar callbacks run.
findings.confidence: high for branch gates and subcalls; insufficient to assign placement-validation meaning
limits: No collision geometry or footprint scan is recovered
Predicate return values are not joined to preview feedback or placement rejection messaging

open_items.why: No island/world origin or frame conversion is visible on the proven parser-to-query path; the dynamic +0x128 implementation is unknown.
Parser leaves vector lane 1 untouched; no ground-height result is traced into final structure Y.
No rotation, pivot, footprint expansion, or per-cell iteration is proven in this call chain.
Field-grid type/state predicates are proven, but not their mapping to can-place, occupancy, collision, water/cliff restrictions, or complete building footprints.
The virtual method at object vtable +0x128 is called with the coordinate pair, but the object's runtime vptr at actor +0x68 is not resolved.
No resolved transition to preview finalization, model/resource binding, collider/PBC consumer, serialized building instance, durable save, or day-change completion.
The six-entry selector is proven, but no selected index is tied to player home, bridge, villager plot, or facility; do not infer by matching counts or geometry.

validation.method: Read-only SQLite direct-call index, pseudocode hash verification, and raw AArch64 disassembly from the hash-identified main.elf.
